items.title: Luke Jensen appointed permanent Chair of National Savings and Investments
items.summary: HM Treasury has appointed Luke Jensen as the permanent Chair of the National Savings and Investments Board for a three-year term starting November 2026.

items.title: PIB Group recruits Aviva executive David Martin as group CEO
items.summary: PIB Group has appointed Aviva's David Martin as its incoming Group Chief Executive Officer, with the transition scheduled for early 2027.

items.title: LMA chief executive Sheila Cameron to step down in early 2027
items.summary: Lloyd's Market Association chief executive Sheila Cameron is stepping down from her role in early 2027, prompting a search for a successor.

items.title: BlackRock flags one fund for failing to deliver value in latest AoV
items.summary: Investment Week reports that BlackRock has identified one fund failing to consistently deliver value alongside 13 requiring improvement.

items.title: NCSC warns UK firms over vulnerabilities from cheap technology
items.summary: Commercial Risk reports that the UK National Cyber Security Centre warns businesses that relying on cheap technology leaves them exposed to AI-powered attacks.

items.title: SiriusPoint appoints former Progressive CFO John Sauerland to board
items.summary: Global specialty underwriter SiriusPoint has appointed former Progressive CFO John Sauerland to its Board of Directors, effective 1 January 2027.
